report_history.health_summary: Your complete blood count shows fantastic overall foundation with healthy red blood cells, white blood cells, and platelet levels, which is wonderful news. Gently building back your iron reserves through targeted nutrition and doctor-guided care will help restore your energy and long-term vitality.
